steps.say: A Venn diagram sorts things into circles. Each circle has a rule.

figure.alt: Venn diagram. Even numbers only: 4. More than 10 only: 15. Both: 12. Outside: 7.

steps.say: Numbers that fit both rules go in the middle, where the circles overlap.
Numbers that fit neither rule go outside the circles.
steps.show: 7 is odd and not more than 10

steps.say: A Carroll diagram uses a grid. Each box has one rule from its row and one from its column.

figure.alt: Carroll diagram. Even and more than 10: 12. Not even and more than 10: 15. Even and not more than 10: 4. Neither: 7.
